subject: Security intake: CAIQ session scheduling, log-transfer cadence & pre-call asks (ApexCloud)
messages:
From: Jordan Hayes <jh@apexcloud.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.co>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ kickoff + logs sample window

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We want to kick off the CAIQ intake for our upcoming procurement review. Two quick asks before we schedule the main walkthrough: 

1) Can you confirm the expected retention/format for request logs and audit trails when using Redwood Private? We need to map to our SOC 2 scope.
2) We need a short dry-run to validate log export — would your team be ok taking a 2-hour window next week for a test transfer (SFTP preferred)?

Attached is a short questionnaire that our security team filled out — feel free to mark sections where you need more info.

Thanks,
Jordan
IT Security Lead, ApexCloud

Attachments: ApexCloud_CAiq_Preflight_Form.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.co>
To: Jordan Hayes <jh@apexcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.co>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.co>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ kickoff + logs sample window

Jordan — thanks, received. Quick responses inline and proposed next steps.

On 2026-08-01 09:12, Jordan Hayes wrote:
> Hi Rishi / Marissa,
> 
> Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. We want to kick off the CAIQ intake for our upcoming procurement review. Two quick asks before we schedule the main walkthrough: 
> 
> 1) Can you confirm the expected retention/format for request logs and audit trails when using Redwood Private? We need to map to our SOC 2 scope.

Retention/format: For Redwood Private we support configurable retention per-tenant. Default is 90 days of full request + response metadata, 365 days for access/audit logs (sha256 digests for responses if customer enables hashed payloads). We can provide log bundles as gzip CSVs or JSONL, and sample extracts can be delivered over SFTP or a pre-authorized AWS S3 presigned URL.

> 2) We need a short dry-run to validate log export — would your team be ok taking a 2-hour window next week for a test transfer (SFTP preferred)?

Yes — we can run a dry-run. Proposed slots:
- Tue 2026-08-03 09:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-08-04 13:00–15:00 PT

Please confirm which works and whether SFTP or S3 presigned is preferred.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa will own the CAIQ walkthrough and annotation of the preflight form.
- Ben will coordinate log export/dry-run and provide the transfer instructions.
- I'll send a calendar invite once Jordan confirms the slot.

Rishi
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Marissa
